lines.text: Twas the night before DEFCON, all through the scene.
Hackers prepped gear, their laptops gleam.
Badges and USBs ready for play.
Dreaming of exploits, end zero day.
Villages buzzed with locks and AI.
Car hacking IoT, all tech to defy.
Exploits exchanged, the air full of thrill, preparing for challenges, skill against skill.
From new to old, white hats and black, and all in between, there's no turning back.
So here's to the hackers, the bold and the bright.
Happy DEF CON to all, and to all, a good night.
